source_crosschecks.finding: Realtime _tool_ausfuehren receives the API call_id, but frank_erinnerung_schreiben dispatches directly in-process through _stern('gespraech-erinnerung-schreiben'), while frank_auftrag_stellen uses a two-step voice confirmation and then self.auftrag.stellen().

claude_frage launches headless Claude with --permission-mode acceptEdits and unconditionally --disallowedTools Bash. Its own source comment states Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob remain available. No --settings argument is passed by claude_frage.

gespraech_erinnerung_schreiben inserts subject/value/source directly into unified.db table gespraech_erinnerung and commits. The tool is deliberately restricted to that table but is a durable state write.
Historical wache-koenig is exact-byte pinned but is Bash-only; current scheduler registration/order remains unproven.

semantic_atoms.claim: A Realtime model function call can cause a durable write to unified.db without passing through Claude Code or the historical Bash watcher: frank_erinnerung_schreiben -> _tool_erinnerung_schreiben -> direct in-process stern.gespraech_erinnerung_schreiben -> INSERT+COMMIT into gespraech_erinnerung.
semantic_atoms.boundary: This proves a source-level durable write path, not that arbitrary canonical facts are accepted. Frankenstein 2.0 must preserve the content as model/user conversation provenance and must not let a model-written memory row silently mint observed-world truth.

semantic_atoms.claim: Voice-confirmed frank_auftrag_stellen eventually starts headless Claude with Bash hard-disabled, but Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob intentionally remain available under acceptEdits. Therefore historical wache-koenig cannot be the final authority for remaining voice-originated state-changing file effects because its source only gates Bash.
semantic_atoms.boundary: Claude Code permission handling may still apply through its own settings stack; this Triggerword-5 source pass does not promote any current global scheduler registration or ordering. The narrower statement is source-proven: the archived Bash-only watcher cannot cover non-Bash Write/Edit effects.

semantic_atoms.claim: The Realtime two-step order confirmation is a useful front-door intent discriminator: same normalized text, a later server-transcribed utterance, <=300s age and no simple contradiction keyword. It is not a canonical EffectDecision: it is not bound to the Realtime call_id, request_digest, generation, causal_event_id, capability/resource identity or final executor identity, and the source explicitly admits lack of speaker verification.

Realtime _tool_ausfuehren already receives call_id and uses it for function_call_output correlation, but the current memory-write and order-confirmation authority state do not bind their durable/external action identity to that call_id. Frankenstein 2.0 can reuse this available call-scoped identifier as one input to immutable invocation identity instead of correlating by free-form text or session-local mutable state.

voice_to_effect_contract: VOICE_FUNCTION_CALL is candidate cognition, not authority.
A modality-specific confirmation may produce USER_INTENT_EVIDENCE but cannot by itself authorize an external or canonical state effect.

Durable conversation memory writes enter a typed MEMORY_WRITE_ADMISSION carrying call_id/invocation_id, request_digest, session_id, generation, causal_event_id when available, source modality, user/model provenance and epistemic class.

File/system/task effects converge after the voice front-gate on one executor-bound EffectRequest -> EffectDecision/CapabilityLease -> EnforcementDecision -> SubmissionReceipt -> ExecutionReceipt -> WorldEffectVerification -> ResultReentry -> CompletionEvidence chain.
Bash disallow remains useful defence in depth for voice-originated headless Claude, but cannot stand in for whole-effect authority because non-Bash state-changing tools remain available.
Successful tool completion or PostToolUse evidence never retroactively creates admission/enforcement authority.
triggerword4_handoff: Route Realtime frank_erinnerung_schreiben through typed memory admission before durable commit; preserve model-generated versus user-observed provenance explicitly.

Keep the current two-step voice confirmation as a front-gate, then require an immutable one-shot EffectDecision bound to the actual call/invocation and exact requested effect before any state-changing executor path.
Prove Write/Edit and every other non-Bash state-changing tool cannot bypass the same deterministic EffectGate.

Add regressions: same text/new call_id cannot reuse a prior decision; wrong request_digest/generation/resource rejected; Bash blocked does not count as Write/Edit coverage; direct memory write without admission rejected; successful execution without prior admission remains ADMISSION_UNKNOWN.

contradiction_update.resolution_delta: The current voice action bridge disables Bash but deliberately leaves file tools available, so the historical Bash-only watcher cannot provide whole-effect coverage for the voice path even if scheduler registration were later proven.

Realtime memory persistence is a direct durable unified.db write driven by model function-call arguments. Preserve it only as typed provenance-bearing memory admission, never as untyped canonical fact creation.

next_exact_gate: Enumerate the remaining Realtime/Claude state-changing tool classes and their final dispatch mechanisms, then require one typed non-Bash-capable executor boundary in the Triggerword-4 assembly; separately recover current global settings registration only as lineage/runtime-reachability evidence, not as the successor architecture.
